description: Code image that carries (sequence, slot, generation) through the SA2 smoke test. The native producer writes it, the harness decodes it from the composited frame, and check_project.py checks the C, C# and Python copies against this file.
bit_to_block: bit i is the block at column i % 8 and row i // 8, both counted from the corner's top-left block
value: code = sequence | slot << 32 | generation << 36 | check << 48; sequence, slot and generation are taken modulo 2^32, 2^4 and 2^12
check: CRC-16/CCITT-FALSE (polynomial 0x1021, initial 0xFFFF, no reflection, final XOR 0) over the six little-endian bytes of code & 0xFFFFFFFFFFFF
fill_rgba8: every texel outside both code areas is (32 + 64 * slot, sequence % 251, 16 * (generation % 16), 255)
decode: read the red channel at each block centre (x0 + 8 * column + 4, y0 + 8 * row + 4); a value of at least 128 is bit 1. A decode is valid when both corners give the same 64-bit value and its check matches
